googlePlayAppIds.title: Google Play package names or URLs
googlePlayAppIds.description: Android package IDs or full URLs, e.g. com.whatsapp, com.spotify.music, or https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.whatsapp

appleAppIds.title: Apple App Store app IDs or URLs
appleAppIds.description: Numeric Apple app IDs or full apps.apple.com URLs, e.g. 310633997 or https://apps.apple.com/us/app/whatsapp-messenger/id310633997

country.title: Country / storefront
country.description: Two-letter country code used for both stores (e.g. us, gb, in, de, ca).

language.title: Language (Google Play only)
language.description: Two-letter language code for Google Play reviews (e.g. en, es, fr, de, hi).

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Maximum number of reviews to scrape per app. Google Play supports thousands; Apple public feed serves the newest reviews per country.

sortGooglePlay.title: Google Play sort order
sortGooglePlay.description: Sort order for Google Play reviews: Newest or Most relevant.

sortAppStore.title: App Store sort order
sortAppStore.description: Sort order for Apple App Store reviews: Most recent or Most helpful.
